Design has 16 distinct clock domains (AC_GND_J6_CLK_IN_N, AC_GND_U10_CLK_N, AC_GND_U11_CLK_IN_N, AC_GND_U3_CLK_REF_N, AC_GND_U7_CLK_REF_N, CLK_ADC_N, CLK_ADC_P, PD_J6_CLK_IN_P, PD_U10_CLK_P, PD_U11_CLK_IN_P, PD_U3_CLK_REF_P, PD_U7_CLK_REF_P, SPI_CLK_J6, SPI_SPI_CLK_U10, SPI_SPI_CLK_U3, SPI_SPI_CLK_U7) but no CDC synchroniser / FIFO / dual-port cell is declared in the BOM. Metastability risk unless RTL adds 2FF synchronisers at every crossing.
